nl: In package.json, set scripts.lint to "eslint src". The file must stay valid JSON with all other values unchanged.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
p = 'package.json'
d = json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8'))
d['scripts']['lint'] = 'eslint src'
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(d, indent=2) + '\n')
EOF
